scope.surface: Narrow inline Files detail after opening PORT_WORKFLOW.md

sharedProductLoss: Both renderers keep a fixed 255/256px explorer beside the editor inside a 359px content surface, leaving only 103px for source.
The resulting source column wraps ordinary code and prose into one- or two-character fragments and is not a usable editor.
Web has no direct Back control in this narrow state because the explorer remains technically present; Lynx exposes Back but still sacrifices the editor to the fixed explorer.
The previous parity gate compared equal outer geometry and therefore treated the same broken allocation in both renderers as a pass.
productBehaviorPassing: Both renderers open docs/PORT_WORKFLOW.md through the shipping Files browser.
Both switch to docs/PORTING_STRATEGY.md through the visible explorer.
Lynx Back restores the Files browser without closing the right panel.
The same project, thread, theme, route, panel width, and snapshot remain selected with zero console errors.
harnessMismatch: The Web Pierre tree did not react to the first outer CDP pointer event; the retained run uses the established composed-shadow DOM click fallback and records that input channel.

The initial report passed because the file-detail gate did not assert a readable editor width or mutually exclusive narrow layout. This is a gate omission, not evidence that the product state was acceptable.
classification.evidenceBoundary: One immutable snapshot, selected project and thread, dark theme, 1024x820 viewport, explicit 360px persisted inline panel width on both renderers, freshly built shipping Web and Lynx-for-Web artifacts, real file open and switch actions, real Lynx Back action, zero console errors, clean process leak gates, and screenshot budget below 100. Native remains unobserved and conservative unknown.

denominatorChange.reason: A narrow inline file-detail panel is a distinct user-reachable combination whose responsive allocation and return path are not represented by the existing 539px desktop detail or 340px sheet states.

validation.workbenchBuild: pass with existing bundle-size and Effect import.meta warnings
